name: Festival Stone of Seedsow
title: Festival Stone of Seedsow
summary: 'The Stone of Seedsow can be found in the woods to the west of the fortress of Lytelthorpe' (Alatar Locke). In the kit the Festival Stone and its Anniversary glow stand on a forest knoll (z 64) inside a cross of four mossy candle sentinels ('Master's Sentinel', 3 m) and four wax candles with blue flames, ringed by tall default-bake trees.

shots.standingOrder: Hold low north-east of the Seedsow stone with the mossy candle sentinels sharp in the foreground against the low sun, then pull focus to the glowing Festival Stone in the wood; stay 3 m from every candle.
shots.notes: Rack focus in the woods west of Lytelthorpe: lens ~3.6 m up, 10 m NE of the Seedsow Festival Stone on its knoll, the mossy candle sentinels sharp in the foreground (proj.mjs: NE candle NDC 0.48,-0.47, east sentinel -0.55,-0.37) with their blue flames against the low golden sun, then focus pulls (at 50 %, 1.8 s) to the stone and its Anniversary glow.
